fixed_grid_scope: Only the original three-node binary64 fixture, two faces, both electron and hole current conventions, and the recorded directions and finite-difference steps; no grid-refinement, model, trajectory or release qualification.

fixture.constant_binding: constants.Q and both vector-flux local q literals have identical binary64 encodings; fixture V_T is its own literal.

acceptance_interpretation.frozen_direct_requirement: The recorded conditional allowances are accepted as candidate-independent accuracy requirements; direct comparison of observed outputs does not assume the unproved elementary-function forward-error contract.
acceptance_interpretation.forward_error_theorem: Claiming the conditional forward-error theorem still requires separately proving its stated NumPy exp/expm1 and basic-arithmetic premises; a passing unit comparison does not establish those premises.
acceptance_interpretation.block_scale_domain: The direction-specific absolute sum is bounded by the block scale only inside that block component box: absolute density components at most their original nodal densities, or absolute potential components at most the fixture thermal voltage; weak/out-of-box directions keep their own recorded scales and limits.
acceptance_interpretation.comparison: Finite observed binary64 values are exact dyadics. Compare the two-product/one-add action against the exact rational reference midpoint and its unchanged absolute allowance; structural/gauge zeros are exact. FD comparisons use the recorded per-entry allowances. Weak actions have no relative-resolution claim.

reference_basis.arithmetic: exact Fraction with outward dyadic rounding

assumptions: nearest-even normal binary64 add/subtract/multiply/divide/square and no contraction changing the declared comparison schedule
exp and expm1 within one neighboring binary64 step of the correctly rounded analytic result for this finite argument set
conditional_arithmetic_contract.rule: exact structural/gauge zeros; otherwise abs(action-reference midpoint)<=reference radius+coefficient error debit+gamma2*(absolute term scale+coefficient debit)
conditional_arithmetic_contract.weak_rule: reference min-absolute magnitude <= absolute allowance: absolute comparison only; no relative-resolution claim
